display.name: PSV Market Making
display.description:
no signal, no view. we quote both sides of btc eth and sol continuously and earn the spread and the rebates.

the profit-share version: no promised interest. depositors buy shares, and their value floats with the strategy's pnl. the manager takes a 20% carry on profit when shares are withdrawn, plus a 2%/yr management fee that accrues continuously. buy while the share price is low and you get more shares.
